outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots are heatmap-style visualizations overlaid on tissue images; individual data points are not meaningful in this context.
Box plots already show the distribution and additionally overlay individual data points (dots) for each biological replicate.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Each bar represents a single derived statistic (log2 fold change from differential expression analysis comparing two groups), not a mean computed across multiple biological replicates that would require individual data points overlaid.
This panel shows representative H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a quantitative plot of averages.
